facts.fact: Requests officially supports Python 3.10 and newer.
Requests no longer supports Python 2.7; support was dropped in Requests 2.28.0.
facts.source_quote: No! As of Requests 2.28.0, Requests no longer supports Python 2.7.

facts.fact: The documented way to install Requests is `python -m pip install requests` (not pipenv or easy_install).
The Requests source repository lives at github.com/psf/requests.
chardet is not a mandatory dependency; unless chardet is already installed or the [use_chardet_on_py3] extra is used, Requests uses charset-normalizer to guess response encodings.
facts.source_quote: and ``chardet`` is not already installed, ``requests`` uses ``charset-normalizer``
